\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 208-211 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R216-first-pass-words-from-chapters-208-211}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a brick and cement.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a pickle, buttermilk, ghee, butter, honey
  \item curry leaves, mustard seeds, spice mix, a prawn, a message
  \item luggage, a seat, a licence, a motorbike, a taxi
  \item a married couple, a bridegroom, a bride, a stranger, a party
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A pickle? (\textbf{\ml{അച്ചാർ}}, \emph{accār}.) Buttermilk? (\textbf{\ml{മോര്}}, \emph{mōrŭ}.) Ghee? (\textbf{\ml{നെയ്യ്}}, \emph{neyyŭ}.) Butter? (\textbf{\ml{വെണ്ണ}}, \emph{veṇṇa}.) Honey? (\textbf{\ml{തേൻ}}, \emph{tēn}.) Curry leaves? (\textbf{\ml{കറിവേപ്പില}}, \emph{kaṟivēppila}.) Mustard seeds? (\textbf{\ml{കടുക്}}, \emph{kaṭukŭ}.) Spice mix? (\textbf{\ml{മസാല}}, \emph{masāla}.) A prawn? (\textbf{\ml{ചെമ്മീൻ}}, \emph{cemmīn}.) A message? (\textbf{\ml{സന്ദേശം}}, \emph{sandēśaṁ}.) Luggage? (\textbf{\ml{ലഗേജ്}}, \emph{lagējŭ}.) A seat? (\textbf{\ml{സീറ്റ്}}, \emph{sīṟṟŭ}.) A licence? (\textbf{\ml{ലൈസൻസ്}}, \emph{laisansŭ}.) A motorbike? (\textbf{\ml{ബൈക്ക്}}, \emph{baikkŭ}.) A taxi? (\textbf{\ml{ടാക്സി}}, \emph{ṭāksi}.) A married couple? (\textbf{\ml{ദമ്പതികൾ}}, \emph{dampatikaḷ}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{\ml{വരൻ}}, \emph{varan}.) A bride? (\textbf{\ml{വധു}}, \emph{vadhu}.) A stranger? (\textbf{\ml{അപരിചിതൻ}}, \emph{aparicitan}.) A party? (\textbf{\ml{പാർട്ടി}}, \emph{pārṭṭi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 212-216 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R216-second-pass-words-from-chapters-212-216}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for art and music.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item art, music, a competition, God, bamboo
  \item a worm, a bat, a koel, a kite, a crane
  \item a torch, a battery, glue, a switch, a saw
  \item a ball, a player, a team, a draw, a hobby
  \item copper, plastic, a plank, a brick, cement
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Art? (\textbf{\ml{കല}}, \emph{kala}.) Music? (\textbf{\ml{സംഗീതം}}, \emph{saṁgītaṁ}.) A competition? (\textbf{\ml{മത്സരം}}, \emph{matsaraṁ}.) God? (\textbf{\ml{ദൈവം}}, \emph{daivaṁ}.) Bamboo? (\textbf{\ml{മുള}}, \emph{muḷa}.) A worm? (\textbf{\ml{പുഴു}}, \emph{puḻu}.) A bat? (\textbf{\ml{വവ്വാൽ}}, \emph{vavvāl}.) A koel? (\textbf{\ml{കുയിൽ}}, \emph{kuyil}.) A kite? (\textbf{\ml{പരുന്ത്}}, \emph{paruntŭ}.) A crane? (\textbf{\ml{കൊക്ക്}}, \emph{kokkŭ}.) A torch? (\textbf{\ml{ടോർച്ച്}}, \emph{ṭōrccŭ}.) A battery? (\textbf{\ml{ബാറ്ററി}}, \emph{bāṟṟaṟi}.) Glue? (\textbf{\ml{പശ}}, \emph{paśa}.) A switch? (\textbf{\ml{സ്വിച്ച്}}, \emph{sviccŭ}.) A saw? (\textbf{\ml{അറക്കവാൾ}}, \emph{aṟakkavāḷ}.) A ball? (\textbf{\ml{പന്ത്}}, \emph{pantŭ}.) A player? (\textbf{\ml{കളിക്കാരൻ}}, \emph{kaḷikkāran}.) A team? (\textbf{\ml{ടീം}}, \emph{ṭīṁ}.) A draw? (\textbf{\ml{സമനില}}, \emph{samanila}.) A hobby? (\textbf{\ml{ഹോബി}}, \emph{hōbi}.) Copper? (\textbf{\ml{ചെമ്പ്}}, \emph{cempŭ}.) Plastic? (\textbf{\ml{പ്ലാസ്റ്റിക്}}, \emph{plāsṟṟikŭ}.) A plank? (\textbf{\ml{പലക}}, \emph{palaka}.) A brick? (\textbf{\ml{ഇഷ്ടിക}}, \emph{iṣṭika}.) Cement? (\textbf{\ml{സിമന്റ്}}, \emph{simanṟŭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
